name: Gasthof Pferdestall
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthof Pferdestall in Neukirchen am Großvenediger**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, just a stone’s throw from the majestic **Großvenediger**, **Gasthof Pferdestall** invites you to experience authentic alpine hospitality. Our cozy guesthouse, surrounded by breathtaking mountain scenery, is the perfect retreat for nature lovers, hikers, and those seeking peace and relaxation.

**Enjoy traditional Tyrolean cuisine** in our rustic dining room, where every dish is prepared with local ingredients. Savor hearty classics like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a perfectly grilled **Venison Schnitzel**, paired with crisp **Tiroler Bier** or fine local wines.

After a day of adventure—whether skiing in **Zell am Ziller**, hiking in the **Hohe Tauern**, or exploring the charming villages of the **Zillertal**—return to your warm, inviting room. Our family-run inn offers comfortable accommodations, from cozy double rooms to spacious family suites, all with stunning views of the surrounding peaks.

**Outdoor enthusiasts** will love our proximity to world-class trails, ski resorts, and scenic spots like the **Krimmler Wasserfälle** or the **Jochberg**. In winter, glide down the slopes of **SkiWelt Zillertal**, and in summer, set off on hikes through alpine meadows dotted with **Edelweiss** and **Alpenrosen**.

At **Gasthof Pferdestall**, we don’t just offer a place to stay—we create unforgettable memories in the heart of **Tirol’s** most stunning landscapes. **Willkommen im Pferdestall!** Come as a guest, leave as family.
